🔥 Firestick reality check: only the 🎮 gamepad-ready ones are pleasant on a TV — pair a Bluetooth controller to your Firestick and open them in the Silk browser. The ⌨️ games need a Bluetooth keyboard + mouse and will feel rough on Firestick hardware. For your 2–3 hours a month on the big screen, your cloud apps are still the better play: Luna has a native Fire TV app, GeForce NOW is on Fire TV, and Xbox Cloud Gaming runs in Silk. These browser ports shine brightest on your PC/Mac browsers with a real keyboard and mouse — no installs, no disk space.
Heads up: these are unofficial browser ports and fan projects. Player counts are a live snapshot — only the Quake ports publish one. "Code updated" comes from the public GitHub repo where available. The GTA 5 port was pulled offline days ago after its host intervened — that card stays as a marker. Some ports may be unavailable at times or need your original game files. Avoid downloading unknown launchers.
Source lists via RadiantOpti on X.
